description: This file provides logging infrastructure stubs for the QUICHE project, including no-op log sinks, fatal and check log sinks, and macros for logging and checking conditions. It does not implement actual logging but sets up the interface and macros for logging behavior.

classes.name: LogStreamVoidHelper
classes.description: Helper class with operator& to facilitate logging macros.

classes.name: NoopLogSink
classes.description: A log sink that does nothing, used for disabling logs.

classes.name: FatalLogSink
classes.description: A log sink that outputs to std::cerr and aborts, used for fatal logs.

classes.name: CheckLogSink
classes.description: A log sink that checks a condition and aborts if false.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Operator for LogStreamVoidHelper, used in logging macros.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns the internal stringstream for logging.
